action.description: create=new (with level) / update=replace whole file / patch=small edit (delta) / remove_file=drop one subfile / delete=remove the whole skill

level.description: create only; defaults to project, global has a high bar

old_string.description: patch: text to replace (must match the live copy uniquely)

files.description: create/update only: subfiles as relative path -> content, under scripts/|templates/|assets/|references/; each must be referenced by its relative path in the SKILL.md body

path.description: remove_file only: relative path of the subfile to remove; the live SKILL.md must no longer reference it (patch the pointer out first)

absorbed_into.description: delete only: the umbrella skill that absorbed this one's content (empty/omitted = pure retirement). The promoter verifies the umbrella actually exists — a hallucinated name rejects the whole intent
